VREAndroids.AndroidGeneDef.label: productivity protocol T3
VREAndroids.AndroidGeneDef.description: Incredible productivity boost, but the cost is the inability to work efficiently at high temperatures.

customEffectDescriptions.li: The lower the temperature, the higher the work speed. Each degree below 20°C grants +2% global work speed, each degree above 20°C grants -2% global work speed.
